result.summary: The promo banner has a text-overflow/layout issue where the offer line wraps onto the CTA button.

issues.description: In the green promo banner, the line “Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10” wraps so that “order €10” sits on top of the white “Order now” button, making the offer text hard to read and the button look crowded.
issues.suggestion: Give the banner copy a dedicated text block with reserved space above the CTA (or shrink/reflow the copy) so the wrapped line never overlaps the button.
